title: The Harlem Globetrotters
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour, part of their 2027 world tour, to the court against the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals, with fans helping decide the action and some getting pulled onto the court. It is for all ages, and a free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 5:00 PM, with Magic Pass at 5:30 PM. It takes place Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO; parking is $20 or $50 for Premium Parking and can be bought in advance or by credit card at the lot entrance.
